# TEMPLATES — Template Architecture

## Purpose
Defines template categories, usage rules, future expansion.

## Categories
Story, episode, scene, dialogue, thumbnail, image, animation, voice, SEO, subtitle, QA, metadata templates.

## AI Instructions
Load appropriate template. Modify inputs, not structure. Keep outputs consistent.

## Best Practices
Use templates as structure guides, not rigid constraints. Modify inputs freely. Confirm outputs match brand, rules, and curriculum requirements. Reference relevant domain docs before using any template.

## Future Expansion
Template library will expand with interactive content templates, parent communication templates, merchandise design templates, multi-language adaptation templates, and analytics reporting templates.
